Original source rationale: Sec. 1212 requires dry standpipe systems to be hydrostatically tested at 20 kg/sq.cm before being declared serviceable for fire-fighting operations.
proposed.explanation: The 20 kg/sq.cm test pressure is significantly higher than normal operating pressure to ensure the system can withstand surge pressures from fire pump activation. Failure at this test pressure indicates defective pipe joints or fittings.
